about: Will GTA 6 come to PC: Rockstar's own GTA 6 page lists two platforms, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and PC is not one. Take-Two's CEO: 'Rockstar always starts on console.' Every main GTA since GTA III reached PC later: III to IV under eight months each, GTA V almost nineteen months (after two console generations), Red Dead 2 just over a year. No GTA 6 PC version announced. Factory Delta #8.
